{{Quote|I'm Kandra Nilitz, Landing Zone NewsNet.|Kandra Nilitz|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
'''Kandra Nilitz''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] with yellow colored skin who was on assignment for [[Landing Zone NewsNet]] at the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Rotunda]] during [[Plan Delta]]. She worked with camera operator [[Beurth Ogh]]. Early in her career, she did an investigative report on black-market sales of fake [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. She was later solicited by the [[Force psychosis|insane]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]] and [[Valin Horn]] to take them off of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in exchange for an exclusive news story. After arriving on Nam Chorios, the Horns abandoned her and Beurth.

Kandra later conducted an interview with the mayor of [[Hweg Shul]], [[Snaplaunce]], who revealed that the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalkers]] could not have stabbed him as they had already taken off in his ship, ''[[Vote Snaplaunce]]''. She then sent communications to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to meet up with her in exchange for a ride. When the Skywalkers and [[Vestara Khai]] arrived, they were attacked by three [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], but the Jedi and Vestara were able to defeat them. In exchange for a ride to [[Crystal Valley]], Luke told Kandra about [[Abeloth]] and the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].
